name: Capture and score local business leads with Serper, Hunter.io and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Local lead capture, end to end

Build a scored prospect list of **local businesses in any niche** — plumbers, dentists, accountants, vets — without touching a scraper.

**How it works:**
1. Sweeps your chosen areas through Google Places (via Serper.dev)
2. Filters out chains and off-topic results, dedupes across overlapping searches
3. Skips anything already in your Google Sheet from previous runs
4. Visits each business's website and contact page to find a real email address
5. Falls back to Hunter.io to find and enrich the contact (name, position)
6. Scores every lead 0–100 and tiers it **Hot / Warm / Cold**
7. Appends everything to Google Sheets
8. *(Optional)* pushes the finished batch to your own CRM, HMAC-signed

**Who it's for:** agencies, freelancers and sales teams prospecting local SMBs.

**Cost:** Serper.dev and Hunter.io both have free tiers — enough for hundreds of leads a month.

---

*Built by **Ali Amin** — [IhsanOps](https://ihsanops.ai), UK AI automation consultancy. Need this customised for your niche or CRM? Get in touch.*

## 1. Configure your search

Everything lives in the **CONFIGURE** block at the top of the *Build search queries* node:

- `BUSINESS_TYPE` — what to search for
- `AREAS` — the areas or postcode districts to sweep
- `NAME_KEYWORDS` / `EXCLUDE_NAMES` — keep results on-topic, skip the big chains
- `DEFAULT_MAX` — leads per manual run

Nothing else in the workflow needs editing.

## 2. Connect your accounts

**Serper.dev** (free tier) — create a *Header Auth* credential: name `X-API-KEY`, value = your Serper API key. Attach it to *Search Google Places (Serper)*.

**Hunter.io** (free tier) — create a *Query Auth* credential: name `api_key`, value = your Hunter API key. Attach it to *Hunter.io email lookup*.

**Google Sheets** — connect OAuth on both Sheets nodes and select the same spreadsheet in each. Put these headers in row 1:

`Company` · `Email` · `Phone` · `Website` · `Address` · `Place ID` · `Captured On`

## How each lead is processed

Homepage → find the contact page → extract an email on the business's own domain → if none, ask Hunter.io → score it: **Email +45 · Phone +25 · Website +20 · Named contact +10** → Hot ≥ 75, Warm ≥ 50, Cold ≥ 25. Every lead lands in the Sheet; only leads with an email or phone are staged for the CRM.

## 3. Optional: sync to your own CRM

Your CRM can start a run by POSTing `{ run_id, maxLeads }` to the webhook trigger. When the run finishes, the captured leads are sent back in one batch, signed with **HMAC-SHA256** (`x-webhook-signature` header) so your CRM can verify the payload is genuine. Set the same `YOUR_SHARED_SECRET` on both sides and put your endpoint in *Send leads to your CRM*.

**Don't have a CRM?** Delete these three nodes and the webhook trigger — Google Sheets works standalone.

nodes.name: Search Google Places (Serper)
nodes.notes: One POST per area. Set to continue on error so a single failed search never kills the whole sweep.

nodes.name: Collect and filter results
nodes.notes: Applies your keyword and exclusion filters, dedupes places that appear in overlapping area searches.

nodes.name: Read existing leads
nodes.notes: Reads the sheet so businesses captured in previous runs are never contacted twice.

nodes.name: Remove already-captured leads
nodes.notes: Compares against the sheet's Place ID column.

nodes.name: Fetch website homepage
nodes.notes: Times out after 12s and follows up to 3 redirects — small-business sites are slow.

nodes.name: Extract email from website
nodes.notes: Only accepts emails on the business's own domain (plus any EXTRA_EMAIL_DOMAINS), so you never scrape a random address from an embedded widget.

nodes.name: Hunter.io email lookup
nodes.notes: Fallback and enrichment: finds an email if the site had none, and adds the contact's name and position when known.

nodes.name: Score and shape the lead
nodes.notes: Email +45, phone +25, website +20, named contact +10 → Hot / Warm / Cold tiers.

nodes.name: Stage lead for CRM
nodes.notes: Quality gate: a lead is only staged for the CRM if it has an email or a phone number.

nodes.name: Sign payload (HMAC)
nodes.notes: Signs the exact JSON string that gets sent, byte for byte. Replace YOUR_SHARED_SECRET with the secret your CRM verifies against.

nodes.name: Send leads to your CRM
nodes.notes: Replace the placeholder URL with your CRM's webhook endpoint, or delete this branch if Sheets is enough.
